item.title: 【Instrumentals / Karaoke (lossy)】PACK - Taylor Swift - Official Instrumentals (Tracker)
item.description:
So I decided to put together all the instrumentals from Tay we got so far (at least the ones I could find), and I made this tracker (an extension of my stems one, only with the instrumentals).

If you have any other, if any link is off (when the TransferIt ones end, I'll re-up), please comment here in this post.

Enjoy! <3
